regions.region: page 1 title, graphical abstract, abstract, and SI marker
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate Pd/XPhos ring-opening coupling claim. The graphical abstract is a generic current transformation, not a separate experiment. An SI availability marker is present, but workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The propargylic-derivative/organometallic coupling arrows are explicitly prior work and are classified as one generic literature example, not current-paper experiments.

The Ti(OiPr)4/EtMgX cyclopropanol-preparation arrow is cited prior work, while the Pd/L cyclopropanol-plus-propargylic-carbonate arrow is the generic current reaction class with desired product and B/C/D competing products. These are classified separately.

regions.region: page 1 optimization prose continuing to page 2
regions.finding: The narrative observations for PPh3, PCy3, rac-BINAP, LB-Phos, Gorlos-Phos, SPhos, and XPhos map to Table 1 rows 1–7 on page 2; no prose-only duplicates were created.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures are generic R-group classes and do not define unique structures or yields.
The graphical abstract does not identify its steroidal substrate/product as a separate run.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, ligand structures, entries 1–12, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Twelve distinct optimization runs were retained with row catalyst/ligand loadings, exact substrate/solvent quantities, 3 h or 6 h time, 50 °C, Cs2CO3 footnote additive, desired/byproduct NMR yields including <3% bounds, 2a recoveries, CH2Br2 basis, and all-case D-type alkyne non-formation.

Twelve cyclopropanol-scope arrows (3aa, 3ba, 3ca, 3da, 3ea, 3fa, 3ga, 3hb, 3ia, 3ja, 3ka, 3jb) were retained separately with shared quantities/conditions, row times/yields, 2a/2b identity, and the 3ea high-loading footnote.
ORTEP of 3ea and the page-4 CCDC data are characterization of the existing Scheme 2 entry, not a separate synthesis or machine-structure verification.

The prose introduces Scheme 3–5 records on page 3, reports a separate gram-scale 3db run at 75%, and states five downstream utility transformations. The utility records remain partial because their detailed Scheme S1 is in unassociated SI.

unresolved: Most scope rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated masses, and yield bases.
The gram-scale 3db sentence omits exact charges and operating conditions.
Synthetic-utility details in Scheme S1 were not imported because SI association is unestablished.

regions.finding: Twelve propargylic-carbonate scope arrows were retained separately with product-specific times/yields, high-loading footnotes for 3ab/3an, 1a = 1.0 mmol overrides for 3ai/3aj, and K3PO4·3H2O/80 °C conditions for 3ak/3al.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 4 and synthetic-utility prose
regions.finding: Two distinct steroidal experiments give 3la (81%, 1.5/1 dr) and 3ld (72%, 1.4/1 dr). Main-text transformations of 3db to 5, 6, 7, 8, and one-pot product 12 were retained as incomplete experiments without importing SI-only details.
Three distinct chirality-transfer runs were retained with exact carbonate scales, starting/product er values, times, and yields. Figure 2 characterizes (R)-3am and is not another preparation.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 6 and control-experiment prose
regions.finding: Four independent control conditions were retained: 1a alone; 2a with EtOH; 2a with t-BuOH; and 1a with propargylic acetate 10a. Product-specific NMR yields, recoveries, non-observation, and the very-slow qualitative result are preserved separately.
The text introduces the proposed catalytic cycle completed on page 4; I–III are proposed intermediates and not experimental preparations.

unresolved: Scope/utility records omit several operational details and yield bases.
The main text says EtOH/t-BuOH products were judged by NMR and isolation but does not give isolated masses/yields.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 7 and mechanistic conclusion
regions.finding: The proposed Pd(0)/XPhos catalytic cycle proceeds through allenyl-palladium methoxide I, ligand-exchanged cyclopropoxide II, beta-C-elimination intermediate III, and reductive elimination to 3. It is classified as mechanism, not a set of isolated reactions.

regions.region: page 4 Associated Content and accession codes
regions.finding: The article lists online experimental/spectroscopic SI and CCDC 1555049/1579063, but no SI file is associated in this workspace. CCDC data characterize 3ea and (R)-3am only; they do not create reactions or verify machine SMILES.

Jing Zhou is thanked for reproducing 3fa, 3al, and (R)-3cg. No independent quantities, conditions, outcomes, or run identifiers are supplied, so provenance is linked to existing records without duplicate experiments.
Bibliography and prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: SI availability in the paper does not establish a workspace SI association.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not define separable runs.
Crystallography supports source assignments but does not certify machine structure encodings.
